purpose: Compute Kuramoto order parameter R for measuring oscillator coherence
description: Computes R = |1/N Σₖ e^(iθₖ)|, the Kuramoto order parameter that measures the coherence of a population of oscillators. R ∈ [0, 1] where R = 0 is fully incoherent and R = 1 is fully synchronized.

signatures.candid: order_parameter : (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 }) -> (float64)

input_types.name: oscillators
input_types.description: Array of (phase θ, natural frequency ω) pairs
input_types.constraints: Must have at least one oscillator

numerical_caveats: R = 1 when all phases are identical
R approaches 0 for large N with random phases

examples.input: [{phase: 0.0, frequency: 1.0}, {phase: π/2, frequency: 1.0}, {phase: π, frequency: 1.0}, {phase: 3π/2, frequency: 1.0}]
